reviews.text: The visual production classes are the most practical part of the course for me. We redo real client-style briefs step by step, and the critiques point out exactly what to fix.
Clear teaching, no filler. My thumbnail click-through improved within two weeks of applying the layout and contrast rules from these sessions.

reviews.classTitle: AI Pro Course — Module 1 · AI Foundations + Design
reviews.text: The design classes changed how I work completely. Every session is practical — we build real thumbnails and portraits in class, not just theory. Doubts are answered live, and the recordings make revision easy.

reviews.classTitle: AI Pro Course — Module 2 · Advanced AI Production
reviews.text: I joined knowing nothing about AI video. By the second module I had generated my first AI avatar video on my own. The pace is friendly for beginners and nothing is rushed.

reviews.classTitle: AI Pro Course — Module 3 · YouTube + TikTok Automation
reviews.text: Strong, hands-on teaching and honest feedback on assignments. One or two sessions ran long, but the content itself was worth it — my faceless channel is finally consistent.
